open_questions: Q1: 'Inscríbete en la Parroquia' (About Us) and 'Inscribirse en Flocknote' (Events) both use https://ourladyofperpetualhelp61.flocknote.com/give — is this the correct join/signup URL, or is there a separate registration URL distinct from the giving URL?
Q2: 'Únase a la Parroquia' quicklink — same question: is this the Flocknote give link, or a separate parish registration form?
Q3: 'Entorno Seguro | Safe Environment' — what is the diocese URL for Safe Environment?
Q4: 'Órdenes Sagradas y Vocaciones' — what is the diocese URL for Holy Orders & Vocations?
Q5: 'Calendario | Calendar' — parish has not yet provided the calendar URL.
Q6: 'Lecturas del Día | Daily Readings' — which website should this link to (USCCB, Magnificat, etc.)?
Q7: 'Santo del Día | Saint of the Day' — which website should this link to?

Q8: 'Santa Misa | Holy Mass' — PDF says 'link to redirect to visit to the sick.' Interpreted as a content link within the article to Anointing/Visit to the Sick page — confirm this is a content note, not a menu redirect.
Q9: Two 'Funerales' pages exist — one under Liturgia, one under Formación en la Fe. Confirm these are two distinct pages. They will need different Joomla aliases at build time to avoid collision.

Q10: 'Escuela de Evangelización' appears as both a top-level menu item and a sub-item under Ministerio Liderazgo ('Redirect to Main menu'). Interpreted as: top-level is the real page, the sub-item is an alias to it. Confirm.
Q11: Social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) — what are the OLPH social media URLs? Where should they appear (header, footer)?
Q12: 'Bienvenidos a OLPH' — video from Father. Will it be embedded (YouTube/Vimeo) or uploaded directly? Awaiting video.
Q13: 'Solicitar un Certificado Sacramental' — what email address should the form submit to?

Q14: Are the two Bautismo items intended as separate pages — 'Sacramentos > Bautismo' (the sacrament) and 'Formación > Preparación para el Bautismo' (baptism prep class)? Both listed separately in PDF.
assumptions: Top-level items with real sub-pages (Sobre Nosotros, Sacramentos, Vida Parroquial, Eventos Parroquiales) classified as heading (non-navigable separator).
Sub-section parents under Vida Parroquial (Ministerio Liderazgo, Liturgia, Finanzas, Mantenimiento, Formación en la Fe) also classified as heading — three-level nesting under Vida Parroquial.
'Equipo de Misión Parroquial' classified as category_grid (staff grid) because PDF specifies image, position, phone, email, bio — per classification rules, any people/team page is always a grid.
'Escuela de Evangelización' under Ministerio Liderazgo classified as alias to the top-level Escuela de Evangelización item (PDF: 'Redirect to Main menu').
'Inscríbete en la Parroquia' (About Us) classified as external_url using the Flocknote URL from the PDF — pending Q1 confirmation.
'Entorno Seguro' and 'Órdenes Sagradas y Vocaciones' classified as external_url to diocese (targets TBD, flagged in open_questions).
'Contadores' classified as single_article — no grid designation in PDF.
'Quinceañera' content_source set to existing — PDF says 'Keep the form - Lupita fillable PDF form.'
'Escuela de Evangelización' top-level classified as single_article (no sub-items in PDF).
Menu item titles use Spanish primary form; English equivalents preserved in PDF are in notes.
Hidden menu left empty — no items require hidden routing not already handled by external_url.
Social media icons treated as module/footer config, not menu items — out of scope for menu spec.
